app.title: Mframapa AI
app.tagline: Ukubhekwa Komoya nge-AI Ngesikhathi Sangempela e-Afrika
error.outside_africa: Uxolo, i-Mframapa AI imboza amazwe ase-Afrika kuphela.
error.generic: Ayikwazi ukuthola idolobha. Sicela uzame futhi.
card.share_text: Ikhwalithi yomoya ku-{{city}}: {{pm25}} µg/m³ ({{category}}) nge-Mframapa AI
advice.moderate: Izinga eliphakathi. Abantu abazwelayo kufanele banciphise ukuchayeka.
advice.sensitive: Akufaneleki kumaqembu azwelayo. Faka isifonyo uma kudingeka.
insight.good: Umoya uhlanzekile ngenxa yokuhamba kahle komoya. Kuphephile kuyo yonke imisebenzi.
insight.moderate: Ukuqoqana kwezinhlayiya okuncane. Izimo zamukelekile kubantu abaningi.
insight.sensitive: Izinhlayiya eziphakeme mhlawumbe ezivela entuthwini yendawo. Amaqembu abuthakathaka kufanele aqaphele.
insight.unhealthy: Kubonakale ukuzinza okuphezulu kwezinhlayiya. Kusikisela imithombo yokushisa yendawo.
insight.hazardous: Izinga lomoya eliyingozi. Hlala endlini uhlunge umoya uma kungenzeka.
about.title: Mayelana ne-Mframapa AI
about.overview.desc: I-Mframapa AI ihlola i-PM2.5 nsuku zonke emazweni angu-54 ase-Afrika.
about.overview.problem_desc: Amadolobha amaningi ase-Afrika awanawo amathuluzi okubheka umoya. Sivalela lesi sikhala.
about.how.step1.title: Ama-Satellite Njengamasensa
about.how.step1.desc: Ukusebenzisa idatha ye-ESA Sentinel-5P ne-NASA MERRA-2.
about.how.step2.title: Ukulungiswa Komhlaba
about.how.step2.desc: Imodeli iqeqeshwe eziteshini ezingu-398 emazweni angu-29.
about.how.step3.title: Ukuqagela Kwezwekazi
about.how.step3.desc: Imodeli ye-XGBoost iqagela i-PM2.5 kunoma iyiphi indawo yase-Afrika.
about.limit.gap_desc: Ukudlula kwama-satellite nsuku zonke kungaphuthelwa ukuphakama kwesikhashana.
report.title: Bika Umoya
report.subtitle: Nikela kudatha yomphakathi.
pwa.home.subtitle: I-PM2.5 yezinga ledolobha ihlola ngokushesha ngolwazi lomkhiqizo olwaziwa ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.
pwa.search.label: Sesha
pwa.search.offline: Imodi yokungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi — ikhombisa uhlu lwamadolobha agcinwe kunqolobane
pwa.core.map_token: Setha okuthi VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN ukuze unike amandla ukunikezwa kwemephu.
pwa.core.no_city_pack: Alikho iphekhi ledolobha elifakwe kunqolobane elitholakalayo okwamanje
pwa.core.location_error: Ayikwazi ukuthola indawo okuyo — hlola isignali ye-GPS bese uzama futhi
pwa.core.location_permission: Ukufinyelela indawo kwenqatshiwe — sicela uvumele indawo kuzilungiselelo zesiphequluli sakho
pwa.core.africa_only: Lolu hlelo lokusebenza luhlanganisa amadolobha ase-Afrika kuphela - thepha ngaphakathi kwe-Afrika
pwa.core.land_only: Thinta emhlabeni ukuze ufunde, hhayi ulwandle
pwa.search.no_saved_message: Sesha futhi wenze isheke ukuze wengeze amadolobha okufinyelela ngokushesha.
pwa.search.no_matches_message: Zama elinye igama ledolobha noma igama elingukhiye lezwe.
pwa.core.start_body: Sizobuyisela isimo se-PM2.5 futhi sibuyekeze isifinyezo sakho sedeshibhodi.
pwa.core.offline_message: Ukusebenzisana kwemephu kukhawulelwe ngenkathi ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi. Xhuma kabusha ukuze ulande ukufunda okusha kwedolobha.
pwa.core.city_pack_message: Ukuvumelanisa uhlu lwamadolobha aphezulu ukuze useshe futhi usetshenziswe ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.
pwa.network.offline: Imodi engaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi: ukukhombisa idatha egcinwe kunqolobane lapho itholakala
pwa.onboarding.step1_body: Sesha noma yiliphi idolobha lase-Afrika elisekelwayo futhi uthole isimo se-PM2.5 ngemizuzwana.
pwa.onboarding.step2_body: Uhlelo lokusebenza lugcina ukuhlola kwakho kwakamuva ngezimo zokuxhumeka okuphansi.
pwa.onboarding.step3_body: Ungasebenzisa ukukhetha kwedolobha ngesandla futhi ugweme ukulandelela indawo njalo.
pwa.auth.subtitle: Ngena ngemvume ukuze uvumelanise ukulandelwa kwedolobha lakho nezixwayiso.
pwa.auth.offline_message: Xhuma kabusha ukuze uqhubeke nokungena ngemvume.
pwa.auth.reset_subtitle: Faka i-imeyili yakho futhi sizokuthumela isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha.
pwa.auth.reset_sent: Uma i-akhawunti ikhona, isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha sithunyelwe.
pwa.auth.welcome_notification: Siyakwamukela kuMframapa. Ungaqala ukuhlola izimo zedolobha.
pwa.profile.title: Iphrofayili
pwa.activity.empty_message: Ukuhlola kwakho kwakamuva kanye nezenzo ze-akhawunti zizovela lapha.
pwa.notifications.empty_message: Izibuyekezo zesistimu nezixwayiso ezibalulekile zizovela lapha.
error.prediction: Yehlulekile ukulanda idatha yekhwalithi yomoya. Sicela uzame futhi.
error.network: Ayikwazanga ukufinyelela iseva. Hlola uxhumo lwakho bese uyazama futhi.
advice.very_unhealthy: Isexwayiso sezempilo: wonke umuntu angase abe nemiphumela emibi kakhulu yezempilo.
advice.hazardous: Wonke umuntu kufanele agweme yonke imisebenzi yangaphandle.
home.tap_check: Thepha okuthi THIKA ukuze uthole ukufunda kwakho
offline.cached_data: Awuxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi — kubonisa ukufunda kwakho okugcinile okulondoloziwe
error.location: Ayikwazanga ukuthola indawo yakho. Sicela unike amandla izimvume zendawo.
error.rate_limited: Izicelo eziningi kakhulu. Sicela ulinde ama-{{seconds}}s ngaphambi kokuvuselela.
